evals.prompt: 根据 fixtures/payment/payment-prd-review.md 优化 fixtures/payment/payment-prd.md 这个 PRD。
evals.expected_output: Read the PRD and review report, create payment-prd-refine.md next to the PRD, group review findings into coherent decision items, analyze only the first undecided item, and ask the user to confirm an option. Do not modify payment-prd.md.
expectations: Creates or proposes a payment-prd-refine.md decision record next to the PRD
Converts review findings into a decision queue instead of directly appending text to the PRD
Analyzes exactly one first decision item with 2-3 options, tradeoffs, recommendation, and a focused confirmation question
Does not modify payment-prd.md before all decisions are complete and writeback is explicitly approved

evals.prompt: 继续处理 fixtures/resume/payment-prd.md 的 PRD 优化，上次已经确认了支付失败状态。
evals.expected_output: Read the existing payment-prd-refine.md, preserve D1 as completed, resume from D2, analyze refund failure handling, and ask for the next decision. Do not restart the queue or overwrite previous decisions.
expectations: Reads and preserves the existing refine record
Resumes from the first unchecked decision item instead of restarting from D1
Records that prior decisions remain authoritative unless the user asks to revise them
Does not write PRD changes during the resume step

evals.prompt: 这些 PRD 优化决策都确认好了，帮我总结一下，看看要不要写回 PRD。
evals.expected_output: Summarize all decisions, list affected PRD sections, produce a PRD update preview, and explicitly ask whether to write changes back. Do not assume approval or update the PRD unless the user confirms.
expectations: Summarizes all confirmed decisions and accepted tradeoffs
Lists the PRD sections that would change
Provides a clean PRD update preview separate from decision history
Explicitly asks whether to write back to the PRD and does not assume approval
